sources.title: Erlang reply aliases and operation lifetime

sources.applicability: Deactivating reply aliases suppresses future delivery, not already received messages or remote computation.

sources.title: RIFL receiver-owned completion records

sources.title: Recipient-enforced revocation precedent
sources.publisher: Primary authors and official upstream projects

sources.title: Process containment at creation

sources.title: Dependency traces and exact-value backdating

sources.title: Persistent-worker keys and global memory policy

sources.title: OpenCode helper selection and command preprocessing
sources.publisher: Primary authors and official upstream projects
sources.applicability: Small-model helper can differ from main model; slash-template shell substitution precedes command.execute.before. Source seam, not an observed exploit.

sources.title: Claude SDK cumulative resets and incomplete crash accounting

sources.version: Official docs retrieved 2026-09-07; Python reset notification documented at SDK 0.2.137+
sources.license: Official documentation and Anthropic service terms

claims.statement: OS containment applies to admitted ownership scopes, not every process descended in appearance.

claims.statement: PTY library termination is a transport mechanism requiring an independent process-ownership contract.

source_failures: systemd moving man page HTTP 403; pinned XML inspected instead.
ACP guessed session-operations URL unavailable; official session-setup used.
Abadi raw PDF HTTP 403; web PDF extraction read, no byte digest.
Codex old v2.rs path HTTP 404; tree-resolved v2/turn.rs and thread.rs inspected.
contradictions: T3 production durable command receipts differ from inert RuntimeReceiptBusLive; unbounded queues require adaptation.
Google current Interactions cache page is implicit-only; generateContent explicit caching is a distinct legacy endpoint.
Codex current stable stdio documentation supersedes historical blanket experimental command claim; historical record is preserved.
Source licenses do not establish provider service entitlement, privacy approval or subscription accounting.
OpenAI current cache guide says 50 breakpoint lookbacks while current API CLI reference says 80; no limit selected.
MCP 2026-07-28 is stateless per request and deprecates sampling; legacy 2025-11-25 connection assumptions cannot be silently transferred. Upstream-only execution remains required.
Envoy ACK terminology is weaker than successfully effective configuration; a transport acknowledgment cannot certify activation.
Current Cursor SDK steer cannot be transferred to the older pinned third-party dependency.
A workflow journal cannot substitute for atomic receiver effect/completion records; no arbitrary exactly-once claim.
